Korean creator Ser0land (새로) makes surreal food-based creations that transform familiar dishes into strange characters and miniature bodies.  Her videos often begin like ordinary cooking (Artvangarde)demonstrations, but the food gradually becomes something completely unexpected: dumplings grow faces, noodles become characters, and soft ingredients are shaped into tiny human-like or creature-like forms. Some of these creations are then cooked, cut or served like ordinary food, making the illusion even stranger. Her work has circulated widely online for exactly this mix of food and unsettling character design.  The result turns cooking into a form of temporary sculpture playful, bizarre, and designed to disappear. #art #artist #scary #foodtok #weird

Wow 🤩 With LEGO bricks, Andrzej Łukomski turns cooking into a creative playground. This Polish stop-motion animator brings miniature food scenes to life using frame-by-frame animation: carefully moving each piece and capturing hundreds of photos to create the illusion of movement. Behind just a few seconds of animation lie hours of patience and precision. By using simple LEGO shapes to recreate everyday gestures — cutting, preparing, pouring — Łukomski transforms ordinary routines into charming and imaginative visual performances. ❤️ Artist: @hypnomotion #art #animation #lego #stopmotion #creator
